question: By how much did the recovered NMC622's first charge capacity fall short of the baseline's?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text, strength FROM atoms WHERE (kind IN ('line','cell','figure_ocr') OR kind LIKE '%fact%') AND (text ILIKE '%mAh%' OR text ILIKE '%capacity%' OR text ILIKE '%first%' OR text ILIKE '%charge%') ORDER BY page, id

WITH t AS (SELECT text FROM atoms WHERE id='p6.L21'), n AS (SELECT CAST(regexp_extract(text, '([0-9]+\.[0-9]+) and ([0-9]+\.[0-9]+) mAh', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS base, CAST(regexp_extract(text, '([0-9]+\.[0-9]+) and ([0-9]+\.[0-9]+) mAh', 2) AS DOUBLE) AS rec FROM t) SELECT round(base - rec, 1) AS shortfall FROM n
